Author: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy

The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
 Criminal Petition No.1546 Of 2020
Order:

-
This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short "Cr.P.C") seeking quash of the charge-sheet in C.C.No.688 of 2019 on the file of the learned I Additional Junior Civil Judge, Narasaraopet of Guntur District.

entities.text: Additional Junior Civil Judge, Narasaraopet of Guntur District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners.
3.
The petitioners are A-1 and A-2 in C.C.No.688 of 2019 on the file of the I Additional Junior Civil Judge, Narasaraopet of Guntur District.

entities.text: I Additional Junior Civil Judge, Narasaraopet of Guntur District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: They are being prosecuted for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273, 420 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and under Sections 58, 59 and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

4. The issue is squarely covered by three judgments of this Court whereunder criminal proceedings launched against various persons in the said petitions of similar nature are quashed by this Court as not maintainable under law.

This Court in Crl.P. No.3731 of 2018 and batch, dated 27-8-2018; in Crl.P. No.5421 of 2019 and batch, dated 18-12-2019; and in Crl.P. No.5103 of 2019 and batch, dated 05-4-2020, held that the prosecution under the aforesaid Sections of law in the facts and circumstances of the case is not maintainable under law.
Therefore, the petitioners herein, who are also similarly placed, who are facing the prosecution for the same nature of offences, are also entitled to the similar relief.

5. Hence, in view of the aforesaid judgments of this Court, the petition is allowed and the criminal prosecution launched against the petitioners in C.C.No.688 of 2019 on the file of the I Additional Junior Civil Judge, Narasaraopet of Guntur District, is hereby quashed.
